purpose: Configuration standards: the canonical shape every Baltor config of a given type must satisfy. Config is the seam where operators tune the system WITHOUT editing code, so config drift is as dangerous as code drift. Every config type declares its schema, version, owner, and environment scope; provider configs declare an emulator + fallback (so a missing real provider degrades to a deterministic offline path, never a crash); connector configs declare tenant scope; retry policies declare DLQ behavior; sync policies declare a cursor + idempotency strategy. SECRET RULE (non-negotiable): no config may contain a raw secret value — only secret REFERENCES (env://… or secret://…), resolved at runtime by SecretsResolver. Templates live under templates/configs/<config_type>/. This file is the single source of the required-field rules enforced by scripts/check_configuration_standards.py.

rules: tenant_policy MUST name the tenant scope it governs
isolation_mode must be one of strict|shared
no raw secrets
connector config MUST declare tenant_scope
auth_ref must be a secret REF (env://… or secret://…), never a raw value
MUST declare a fallback_fixture (deterministic offline source)
provider config MUST declare an emulator (offline stand-in) and a fallback provider
credentials only as secret REFs
no raw secrets
sync policy MUST declare a cursor_strategy and an idempotency_strategy
cursor_strategy in the connector-catalog cursor_strategy_enum
no raw secrets
watch policy MUST declare a freshness TTL and a revocation behavior
no raw secrets
retry policy MUST declare dlq_behavior (what happens after max_attempts)
max_attempts is a finite integer (no infinite retry)
no raw secrets
queue policy MUST declare lease_seconds and whether idempotency is required
no raw secrets
rate limit policy MUST declare an on_exceed behavior (backoff|reject|queue)
no raw secrets
security policy MUST declare encryption + PII redaction + secret resolution
secret_resolution names the resolver scheme, never a key
no raw secrets
object store config MUST declare a fallback (local store) for offline determinism
credentials only as secret REFs
no raw secrets
vector store config MUST declare a fallback (local deterministic store)
dimensions imported from the shared schema dimension constant (no parallel literal)
no raw secrets
api_key_ref MUST be a secret REF (env://OPENAI_API_KEY style), never a raw key
MUST declare an emulator (offline stub) and a fallback provider
vendor SDK lives only behind the gateway
no raw secrets
optimization policy MUST declare a regression_gate and an answer_coverage_floor
promote_threshold cannot waive the answer-coverage floor
no raw secrets
reconciliation policy MUST declare authority_order and freshness_window_seconds
held_out_on_loss MUST be true (the loser is never dropped silently)
no raw secrets
